Closing a File When a file is closed, Persistency shall ensure that all changes to the file are persisted. This does not need to be done immediately like when ara::per:: WriteAccessor::SyncToFile is called, but may happen at a later time, latest when the file is opened again, or ara::core::Deinitialize is called.
If creationTime, modificationTime, or accessTime are not available, they shall be set to 0.
